amendment: AMENDMENT 1 applied: permitted surface widened to any host under the hyperliquid.xyz domain suffix, read-only, unauthenticated. /exchange still forbidden on every host, enforced in code (ForbiddenPath).

cp1_1_probe_address.source: first-party leaderboard (stats-data.hyperliquid.xyz/Mainnet/leaderboard), ranked by day pnl
cp1_1_probe_address.note: The #1 wallet by day pnl (0xe6111266...) has day vlm=0.0 and returned ZERO fills across 24h/7d/30d windows - recorded as a finding, not an error. Moved to the highest-pnl wallet with non-zero volume.

types.note: all monetary/size fields are STRINGS and must be parsed explicitly downstream

startPosition_signed.evidence: dir='Open Short', side='A', startPosition='-90850.2014' - negative on a real short

cp1_2_fills.dir_caveat: Only one 0.4h page of ONE wallet was sampled, so this is NOT the full dir vocabulary. The complete set will be recorded from the CP4 bulk pull.
cp1_2_fills.page_cap_note: exactly 2000 rows returned for a 7d request spanning only 0.4h of wall time -> 2000 is the per-response cap; CP4 MUST paginate backwards and dedup by tid

sign_convention.verified_how: sample entry has szi=-1707.27 (SHORT) with fundingRate=+0.0000125; under a positive funding rate longs pay shorts, so a short receives - and usdc is +1678.398244. Sign split on this wallet: 443 positive / 57 negative.

prior_attempts_on_info.result: all HTTP 422 - /info exposes no leaderboard method

cp1_6_throttle.backoff: exponential on HTTP 429, max 5 retries, then log and continue
cp1_6_throttle.cross_process_verified: YES - process A backfilled to 20, fresh process B read 20, process C made one call to 21, fresh process D read 21
cp1_6_throttle.host_guard: enforced - ForbiddenHost on anything not under hyperliquid.xyz (incl. spoofed evil-hyperliquid.xyz.attacker.com), ForbiddenPath on any path containing 'exchange'

self_check: self-check found the request counter was per-process and under-reported (a probe printed 'requests used: 1' when the true total was 20). Fixed by persisting the counter to receipts/request_counter.json, loading it at client startup, backfilling 20, and proving cross-process visibility with four separate interpreters (A write -> B read -> C increment -> D read). Also found the #1 leaderboard wallet by day pnl returns zero fills with vlm=0.0; not a bug, recorded as a finding and the probe moved to the top wallet with non-zero volume.
